scientific_integrity: Exact stationary continuous-time two-dimensional Gaussian Langevin model; exact pairwise chord signal-to-noise only. No inference about correlated-sample performance or numerical finite-step integration. The analytic proof supplies the parameter-uniform statements; deterministic tests are not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Requires independent positive white-noise baths with distinct temperatures, nonzero symmetric subcritical coupling and a stationary initial law; no angular-ratio, path-integrated area, multiple-chord statistical efficiency or experimental measurement error considered. Independent scientific priority review not performed.
title: A unique temperature-independent optimal sampling lag for Brownian-gyrator circulation
